data.body: **[P2] Validate discovered groups before constructing plugins.** This validation runs only after every selected provider factory. OTel constructors install a global root-logger filter, so a conflicting environment configuration can raise while leaving a filter bound to a discarded plugin; if the error is caught and a valid handler is initialized in the same process, idempotent installation retains that stale filter and log correlation is lost. Resolve all provider metadata and preflight `provider.plugin_type.exclusive_group` before invoking any factories, with a regression test that conflict detection leaves global instrumentation untouched.
